offering_description.value: Operates a portfolio of online dating apps and websites that sell paid memberships and in-app features to singles seeking romantic relationships. It runs the apps as software platforms, earning most revenue from subscriptions and some from advertising.

primary_products.value: online dating apps; dating websites; paid premium memberships

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual adults seeking dates or long-term relationships

revenue_model.value: subscription: paid memberships for premium dating app features; advertising: in-app and website ads from third-party advertisers

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: operates dating apps and matching platforms, sold to individual users

geography_served.value: global: worldwide, with large user bases in North America, Europe and Latin America

specialization.value: niche specialist: online dating apps and websites offered under several brands

distribution_channels.value: online: mobile app and website sign-ups and payments; third-party retail: app stores where users download the apps

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: consumer protection, data privacy and online safety rules, such as GDPR and age verification requirements
